# IntsInput { #anylumino.IntsInput }

```python
IntsInput(
    value=(),
    allowed_tags=None,
    allow_duplicates=False,
    description='',
    disabled=False,
    **kwargs,
)
```

List input for integer values.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name             | Type     | Description                                   | Default   |
|------------------|----------|-----------------------------------------------|-----------|
| value            | optional | Initial value and synced Python value.        | `()`      |
| allowed_tags     | optional | Optional allowed values for tag-style inputs. | `None`    |
| allow_duplicates | optional | Whether duplicate entries are allowed.        | `False`   |
| description      | optional | Label shown above the control.                | `''`      |
| disabled         | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled.         | `False`   |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [control_kind](#anylumino.IntsInput.control_kind) | A trait for unicode strings. |
